properties.title: General Warning
properties.body:
[South-eastern Baltic] LITHUANIAN NAV WARN 058/26
SOUTH-EASTERN BALTIC.
MILITARY EXERCISES 0900–1500 UTC DAILY
27 AND 28 AUG IN AREA EYD-18, CENTERED
IN 55-29.6N 020-51.0E.
AREA TEMPORARILY DANGEROUS TO SHIPPING.
WIDE BERTH REQUESTED.
CANCEL THIS MSG 281600 UTC AUG 26.
